source: Mnn…
{i}(Ah… Aiden’s still asleep...){/i}
translation: {i}（啊……Aiden还在睡……）{/i}

source: {i}(He’s so warm and calm… I can feel him breathing beneath my arm…){/i}
translation: {i}（他温暖又安静……我能感觉到他在我的手臂下呼吸……）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s good to know he’s feeling much better after everything that happened last night…){/i}
translation: {i}（经历昨晚的一切后，知道他已经好多了，真让人安心……）{/i}

source: {i}(I hope I can protect him like this always…){/i}
translation: {i}（希望我能永远像这样保护他……）{/i}

source: *hugs tight*
translation: *紧紧拥抱*

source: Mmhh…
translation: 嗯哼……

source: Yoshi…?
translation: Yoshi……？

source: Ah, Aiden… Did I wake you up?
translation: 啊，Aiden……我把你吵醒了吗？

source: Mm-hm… I don’t mind…
translation: 嗯哼……我不介意……

source: {i}(Aiden’s hand grasped mine tighter, and I could feel the warmth of his body even more.){/i}
translation: {i}（Aiden把我的手握得更紧，我更清晰地感受到了他身体的温度。）{/i}

source: {i}(Despite being together so often, we rarely get to share a bed and cuddle like this…){/i}
translation: {i}（尽管我们经常在一起，却很少有机会同床相拥。）{/i}

source: I thought I was dreaming, Yoshi…
translation: 我还以为自己在做梦，Yoshi……

source: I never thought the day would come that I’d wake up to you hugging me…
translation: 从没想过有一天醒来时，你会这样抱着我……

source: Me either… I wish we could stay like this forever…
translation: 我也没想过……真希望我们能永远保持这样……

source: Yoshi…
translation: Yoshi……

source: Yes, Aiden…?
translation: 怎么了，Aiden……？

source: A-About what happened last night…
translation: 关、关于昨晚发生的事……

source: I… I’m really sorry about the whole thing…
translation: 我……我真的很抱歉，把一切弄成那样……

source: No, Aiden. You don’t have to apologize…
translation: 不，Aiden。你不必道歉……

source: Everything you felt and said was totally valid. Stuff like that happens when we’re pushed to our limits, after all.
translation: 你的所有感受和话语都完全合理。毕竟人被逼到极限时，难免会发生这种事。

source: I mean, you saw how I was last term when we almost closed down the camp…
translation: 你也看到了，上个营期营地差点关闭时，我是什么样子……

source: Yeah… I guess it’s kinda the same…
translation: 是啊……好像确实差不多……

source: We’re all only human, Aiden. We’re allowed to have bad days every now and then; and it had been eating at you for so long, of course you lost control.
translation: 我们都只是普通人，Aiden。偶尔状态糟糕是可以的；那些事折磨了你那么久，你当然会失控。

source: Well, you know me, I’m not used to being so vulnerable like that…
translation: 这个嘛，你了解我，我不习惯像那样暴露自己的脆弱……

source: I’m really embarrassed about it…
translation: 我真的觉得很丢脸……

source: There’s nothing to be embarrassed about, Aiden… Showing your weakness doesn’t make you any less of a person.
translation: 没什么好丢脸的，Aiden……展现脆弱并不会让你变得低人一等。

source: It actually makes me see you as even stronger than I did before.
translation: 事实上，这反而让我觉得你比以前更加坚强。

source: You’re someone who can light up a room. I can always count on you to cheer me up when I’m feeling overwhelmed.
translation: 你是能让整个房间都明亮起来的人。每当我不堪重负时，总能指望你让我振作。

source: Because of that, I can totally understand why you feel so frustrated when you’re in that sort of situation.
translation: 正因如此，我完全能理解你陷入那种处境时为什么会如此沮丧。

source: Y-Yeah… That’s exactly it…
translation: 是、是啊……正是这样……

source: I’m just glad you trusted me enough to tell me all of that. It really means a lot to me, Aiden.
translation: 我只是很高兴你足够信任我，愿意告诉我这一切。这对我意义重大，Aiden。

source: To know that you let me into the deepest and darkest thoughts you had, it really made me realize that you’re the one I want to fight for the most…
translation: 知道你让我走进内心最深、最黑暗的角落，真的让我意识到，你就是我最想为之奋战的人……

source: Thanks for helping me get through it, Yoshi…
translation: 谢谢你帮我熬过这一切，Yoshi……

source: I never thought I’d see the day where I had to let everything out…
translation: 我从没想过，自己有一天会把一切都倾诉出来……

source: I feel like a huge weight has been lifted from my shoulders… And I’m really grateful it was you who did it…
translation: 感觉肩上的千斤重担终于卸下了……而我真的很庆幸，帮助我的人是你……

source: You know you can count on me. I really meant what I said to you last night…
translation: 你知道可以依靠我。昨晚对你说的每一句话，我都是认真的……

source: Ah, yeah… About that too…
translation: 啊，对了……还有那件事……

source: I didn’t get the chance to respond…
translation: 我还没来得及回应……

source: All these years I’ve been holding back, and I don’t know why…
translation: 这么多年来我一直克制自己，却不知道为什么……

source: I thought to myself… I was already lucky enough to have met you…
translation: 我总对自己说……能够遇见你已经足够幸运……

source: When we got back together, things were so different.
translation: 当我们重逢时，一切都已经如此不同。

source: I was just happy to be around you again, and I was afraid to lose what we had when we were younger.
translation: 我只是很高兴又能陪在你身边，也害怕失去年轻时我们拥有的一切。

source: I didn’t want to risk the only chance I had, so I kept my feelings to myself…
translation: 我不想拿唯一的机会冒险，所以一直把感情藏在心里……

source: But, even when you did, Aiden… I felt it in every single day we were together…
translation: 可是，即使你没有说出口，Aiden……在我们共度的每一天里，我都能感受到……

source: I felt how much you cared for me, and how happy you were with me…
translation: 我能感受到你有多在乎我，和我在一起时有多幸福……

source: Yeah… The one thing I’ve always wanted to tell you is that…
translation: 是啊……我一直想告诉你的那句话就是……

source: I’ve always loved you, Yoshi…
translation: 我一直都爱着你，Yoshi……

source: I love you too, Aiden…
translation: 我也爱你，Aiden……

source: {i}(Our lips touched once again but compared to last night I felt nothing but happiness and a sense of relief that Aiden felt the same way I do.){/i}
translation: {i}（我们的双唇再次相触，但与昨晚不同，此刻我心中只有幸福，以及得知Aiden与我心意相同后的释然。）{/i}

source: Heh… It’s funny, isn’t it…?
translation: 呵……挺好笑的，对吧……？

source: We were both just waiting for each other this whole time…
translation: 原来这段时间里，我们一直都在等着彼此……

source: There was nothing I should’ve been afraid of, after all…
translation: 结果我根本没有什么需要害怕的……

source: I don’t know what held me back either… But all I know is I’ve always wanted to be there for you.
translation: 我也不知道自己为什么迟迟不敢迈出那一步……但我只知道，一直都想陪在你身边。

source: And I don’t think we’ve missed out on anything together. I’ve gotten to hold you like this even when you weren’t my boyfriend.
translation: 而且我觉得我们并没有错过什么。即使你还不是我的男朋友，我也已经能像这样抱着你。

source: Boyfriend? Hehe… I really like the sound of that…
translation: 男朋友？嘿嘿……我真喜欢这个称呼……

source: We’ve done so much even without that label, though.
translation: 不过即使没有那个称呼，我们也已经一起做过很多事了。

source: Hehe, yeah, we have. Who are we kidding at this point?
translation: 嘿嘿，是啊。事到如今，我们还在骗谁呢？

source: Guess you could call this entire trip our honeymoon then?
translation: 那这整趟旅行是不是可以算作我们的蜜月？

source: Well, I’ve been thinking… This vacation has been our only private time together and I feel bad for being so down in the dumps for half the trip.
translation: 这个嘛，我一直在想……这次假期是我们唯一的独处时间，可我有一半旅程都情绪低落，感觉很对不起你。

source: Haha, don’t worry, Aiden. You didn’t mess it up at all – this entire time with you has been great.
translation: 哈哈，别担心，Aiden。你完全没有搞砸——和你共度的全部时光都很美好。

source: You know what I mean, Yoshi! I gotta make it up to you, it’s the least I can do!
translation: 你知道我的意思，Yoshi！我得好好补偿你，这是我至少该做的！

source: Hug tightly.
translation: 紧紧抱住他。

source: {i}(I could feel myself heating up against his back, trying to resist the temptation for some reason.){/i}
translation: {i}（我能感觉到自己贴着他的后背逐渐发烫，却不知为何仍试图抵抗诱惑。）{/i}

source: Why’d you close your eyes, Yoshi? I thought we were done holding back?
translation: 为什么闭上眼睛，Yoshi？我以为我们已经不再克制了？

source: And besides, from what’s poking my butt, I can tell part of you doesn’t wanna resist~
translation: 而且从顶着我屁股的东西来看，你身体的某一部分可不想抵抗～

source: Ah…!
You’re the big spoon now, so you get to be in charge.
translation: 现在你从后面抱着我，所以由你来主导。

source: How about I give you a clearer view and let you play for a bit before I make my move?
translation: 不如让我给你看得更清楚，在我行动前先让你玩一会儿？

source: Grope his pecs.
translation: 揉捏他的胸肌。

source: Ehh… Y-Yoshi…
translation: 呃……义、Yoshi……

source: I hope you’re ready, Aiden…
translation: 希望你准备好了，Aiden……

source: Lean for a kiss.
translation: 倾身亲吻。

source: {i}(We were both hot, filled with desire for each other...){/i}
translation: {i}（我们浑身滚烫，充满了对彼此的欲望……）{/i}

source: Haaahh~
translation: 哈啊～

source: {i}(Aiden took over and stuck his tongue out, entwining it with mine.){/i}
translation: {i}（Aiden夺过主动权，伸出舌头，与我的舌头缠绕在一起。）{/i}

source: A-Aaah…
translation: 啊、啊啊……

source: {i}(He was tangling our tongues so skillfully that I couldn’t help but give in.){/i}
translation: {i}（他如此娴熟地交缠着我们的舌头，让我忍不住彻底屈服。）{/i}

source: {i}(At this rate, I wanted to take my turn and get a taste of the rest of his body…){/i}
translation: {i}（照这样下去，我也想轮到自己，品尝他身体的其他部位……）{/i}

source: Jack him off.
translation: 给他打手枪。

source: Ah, that’s what I thought~
translation: 啊，我就知道～

source: A-Aaah, Yoshi…!
translation: 啊、啊啊，Yoshi……！

source: Uwaah… Ahh~
translation: 呜哇……啊～

source: {i}(At this rate, I wanted to make the most out of his body…){/i}
translation: {i}（照这样下去，我想尽情享用他的身体……）{/i}

source: {i}(Still filled with passion, we finished up with a tender kiss…){/i}
translation: {i}（激情仍未褪去，我们以一个温柔的吻结束了一切……）{/i}

source: {i}(I would never forget this moment with Aiden…){/i}
translation: {i}（我永远不会忘记与Aiden共度的这一刻……）{/i}

source: Nnnn! *stretches*
translation: 嗯——！*伸懒腰*

source: Call it whatever, but it’s great to end the trip with a blast! Literally!
translation: 随你怎么说，能用这么爽的一发为旅行收尾真不错！而且真的是“一发”！

source: I haven’t felt that good in a while!
translation: 我已经很久没这么爽过了！

source: But what about the other nigh—
translation: 可前几晚的那次——

source: Mm-mm! I know what you’re gonna say, but the time at the bar doesn’t count!
translation: 不不！我知道你想说什么，但酒吧那次不算！

source: I barely remember what it felt like because of how drunk I was!
translation: 我当时醉得太厉害，几乎不记得是什么感觉！

source: Let’s just say you were a lot looser and relaxed then…
translation: 只能说你当时放松得多，也松得多……

source: Ugh!! Must’ve felt like heaven!
translation: 呃啊！！那一定爽上天了！

source: Oh boy, it did. It’s hard to forget that detail. You looked like you were having the best time.
translation: 天啊，确实如此。那个细节很难忘记。你看起来享受极了。

source: Sucks I can’t even remember! Not fair!
translation: 偏偏我什么都不记得，太亏了！不公平！

source: Well, I’m glad I at least scored two out of three days with you. Not to mention, I’m coming out of here with you as my boyfriend.
translation: 好吧，至少这三天里有两天和你做了，我已经很满足。更别说离开这里时，你已经成了我的男朋友。

source: Sheesh… Saying that still feels unreal! I just got chills!
translation: 天啊……说出这句话还是觉得不真实！我都起鸡皮疙瘩了！

source: Or it’s because you’re wearing nothing but your underwear. I can’t help but notice how cold it looks outside right now.
translation: 也可能是因为你只穿着内裤。外面现在看起来真的很冷。

source: Whoa, you’re right…! The window’s super hazy, and the city looks really dull now from all the snow.
translation: 哇，你说得对……！窗户蒙着一层雾，整座城市被大雪覆盖后显得灰蒙蒙的。

source: Hahaha, did you really only just notice? It’s been like that since we woke up.
translation: 哈哈哈，你现在才注意到吗？从我们醒来时就一直这样。

source: Haha! It’s such a shame we can’t do it back at camp since we started sharing rooms with everyone, huh?
translation: 哈哈！自从开始和大家同住一间房，我们回营地后就不能做了，真可惜，对吧？

source: Ugh, you said it! And even if we did have some privacy, we’d be too exhausted from how busy we are every day…
translation: 呃，可不是嘛！就算真有私人空间，每天忙成那样，我们也会累得没力气……

source: But eh… We can always figure out how to fix that when we get home!
translation: 不过嘛……等回家后，我们总能想出办法解决！

source: Ugh, I seriously can’t wait to go back to camp today… I actually started packing last night when I couldn’t sleep.
translation: 呃，我真的等不及今天回营地了……昨晚睡不着时，我其实已经开始收拾行李。

source: Your bag is done too, so we can just grab and go!
translation: 你的包也收拾好了，我们拿上就能走！

source: Way to think ahead. I can’t wait to get back to camp either.
translation: 想得真周到。我也等不及回营地了。

source: Anyway, it’s getting late... I wonder why nobody has called for us yet…
translation: 总之，时间已经不早了……不知道为什么还没人来叫我们……

source: Maybe they forgot…? Or maybe they’re still asleep.
translation: 也许他们忘了……？或者还在睡。

source: I doubt it. I don’t think the hotel would let us overstay, after all…
translation: 我觉得不可能。酒店应该不会让我们逾期停留……

source: Maybe they’re already waiting for us downstairs…?
translation: 也许他们已经在楼下等我们了……？

source: You’re probably right… Sir Goro does get a little frantic whenever it’s time to leave a place…
translation: 你可能说得对……每次该离开某个地方时，Goro先生都会有点手忙脚乱……

source: Should we go down to the lobby and check out just to be sure?
translation: 我们要不要下楼去大厅看看，顺便办理退房？

source: Yep, I’m good with that! We’re all packed up and ready to go anyways!
translation: 好啊！反正我们已经收拾妥当，随时可以出发！

source: We’re not going out there in just our underwear, Aiden.
translation: 我们不能只穿内裤就出去，Aiden。

source: Oh, right! Hahaha!
translation: 哦，对！哈哈哈！

source: Ah, it looks like we got here just in time, everyone else seems to be here already.
translation: 啊，看来我们来得正是时候，其他人似乎已经全到了。

source: Looks like there’s a commotion over there, too.
translation: 那边好像还发生了骚动。

source: So, you’re saying we're stuck here?! This is unacceptable!
translation: 所以你的意思是，我们被困在这里了？！这不可接受！

source: We’re only following protocols, ma’am, please underst—
translation: 我们只是在遵守规定，女士，请您理——

source: I want to speak to the manager!
translation: 我要见你们经理！

source: Yikes… Looks like Emilia’s making a scene again…
translation: 糟糕……看来Emilia又在闹事……

source: Hmm… It sounds pretty serious, though.
translation: 嗯……不过听起来事情相当严重。

source: Goooooooooood morning, you two~! Lovely day we’re having today, aren’t we?
translation: 早——上——好，你们两个～！今天真是美好的一天，对吧？

source: Not accurate, Lloyd…
translation: 这说法并不准确，Lloyd……

source: Oh hey, guys.
translation: 哦，嘿，各位。

source: What’s up with the huge crowd this morning? Is everyone really that excited to go home too?
translation: 今天早上怎么聚了这么多人？大家也都这么期待回家吗？

source: Got any idea what’s going on?
translation: 知道发生什么了吗？

source: W-Well… A really large snowstorm blew in last night, and now all the roads are covered in snow…
translation: 这、这个嘛……昨晚来了一场特别大的暴风雪，现在所有道路都被积雪覆盖了……

source: Our shuttle cancelled the ride back today since the roads aren’t safe…
translation: 因为道路不安全，接驳车取消了今天的返程……

source: Oof… Sounds bad.
translation: 唔……听起来很糟。

source: Yeaaahhh… We can’t get back to work at this rate… I’m just hoping the storm didn’t hit the site.
translation: 是啊——……这样我们就没法回去工作了……只希望暴风雪没袭击工地。

source: Don’t jinx it, Lloyd.
translation: 别乌鸦嘴，Lloyd。

source: Ah, there you are, everyone. You all must’ve heard the news, right?
translation: 啊，大家都在这里。你们应该都听到消息了吧？

source: Yes, sir. This is quite unexpected.
translation: 是的，先生。确实出乎意料。

source: It’s all over the news, too. It seems that the entire capital welcomed winter with a blizzard.
translation: 新闻也全在报道。看来整座首都以一场暴风雪迎来了冬天。

source: Dad and I got woken up last night as soon as it hit. But we didn’t think it’d be this bad.
translation: 昨晚暴风雪刚来，我和爸爸就被吵醒了。但没想到会这么严重。

source: The good news is that it’s already passed, and the clean-up operations are already underway.
translation: 好消息是暴风雪已经过去，清理工作也已经展开。

source: I’ve already called Mr. Clermont and he’s aware of our situation.
translation: 我已经打电话给Clermont先生，他了解我们的情况。

source: Ughhh… Just when I thought this vacation couldn’t get any better…
translation: 呃啊……我还以为这次假期已经不可能变得更糟了……

source: Don’t stress yourself out, dear. It’s out of anyone’s control.
translation: 别给自己太大压力，亲爱的。这是谁都无法控制的事。

source: I’m actually talking about Emilia, Dad… I thought she’d give her obnoxious behavior a break, especially after the fuss she made last night.
translation: 其实我说的是Emilia，爸爸……昨晚闹出那么大动静后，我还以为她至少会暂停一下讨厌的行为。

source: I mean, look at her! She’s been harassing that poor bellboy for a solid thirty minutes now!
translation: 你看看她！她已经足足刁难那个可怜的行李员三十分钟了！

source: At this point, it must be her hobby…
translation: 事到如今，这一定是她的爱好……

source: What’s new?
translation: 这有什么稀奇的？

source: Sh-Should someone try and stop her…? We might get kicked out of here… I don’t wanna stay outside covered in snow…
translation: 是、是不是该有人去阻止她……？我们可能会被赶出去……我不想浑身是雪地待在外面……

source: Let me handle her.
translation: 让我来处理。

source: Don’t you know how much is at stake by keeping us locked up in here?! We’re already behind schedule with our project!
translation: 你难道不知道把我们困在这里会造成多大损失吗？！我们的项目进度已经落后了！

source: Like I said ma’am… There’s really nothing we can do about it… We will not risk your safety—
translation: 就像我说的，女士……我们真的无能为力……我们不能拿您的安全冒险——

source: Ugh! I wouldn’t be surprised if this was just a ploy to force us into paying for another night!
translation: 呃！如果这只是逼我们多付一晚房费的伎俩，我一点都不会惊讶！

source: Where do you think we’ll get the money to pay for something outrageous like this?!
translation: 你以为我们去哪里弄钱，支付这么离谱的费用？！

source: Calm down, Ms. Komarova.
translation: 冷静，Komarova小姐。

source: I’ve already talked to Mr. Clermont, and he’s arranged the accommodations for us.
translation: 我已经和Clermont先生谈过，他替我们安排好了住宿。

source: Y-Yes, ma’am… Our policy states that all VIP guests are insured for emergencies like this. We will not charge you for your extended stay.
translation: 是、是的，女士……根据我们的政策，所有VIP客人都享有此类紧急情况的保障。延期住宿不会收取费用。

source: Y-You should’ve said that sooner, then!
translation: 那、那你应该早点说！

source: That’s what I was trying to say, ma’am…
translation: 女士，我刚才正想说明这一点……

source: Would you kindly escort her to her room, please?
translation: 麻烦你送她回房间，可以吗？

source: Y-Yes, gladly…! This way, ma’am!
translation: 是、是的，乐意效劳……！女士，这边请！

source: And what about my bags?! You’re not expecting me to carry them back all the way to the top floor again, are you?!
translation: 那我的行李呢？！你该不会指望我再自己搬回顶楼吧？！

source: A-Ah, of course! My apologies! Let me call more staff to assist everyone with their luggage too!
translation: 啊、啊，当然不会！非常抱歉！我这就多叫几名工作人员，也帮大家搬运行李！

source: *sigh* I’m not getting paid enough for this…
translation: *叹气* 这点工资根本不值得我受这种罪……

source: Oh, thank god, she’s gone. That’s one way to get rid of her, Dad.
translation: 哦，谢天谢地，她终于走了。爸爸，这确实是赶走她的好办法。

source: Well… let’s try not to get carried away by her antics. On the bright side, we have an extra day here to relax.
translation: 这个嘛……别让她的胡闹影响大家。往好处想，我们多了一天时间在这里放松。

source: Yeah, I’m not complaining! I won’t say no to more fancy living!
translation: 是啊，我可没意见！多享受一天豪华生活，我才不会拒绝！

source: What do you guys think we should do now…? I’ve ran out of things to do here.
translation: 你们觉得现在该做什么……？我在这里已经没事可做了。

source: You’ve barely left your room the last two days, Jin.
translation: 过去两天你几乎没离开过房间，Jin。

source: Actually, I’m in the same boat as Jin here. Knowing we were gonna go home today, I made sure I tried everything I wanted to yesterday.
translation: 其实我和Jin一样。因为知道今天要回家，昨天我已经把想体验的东西都试了一遍。

source: Maybe we should just chill in the café for now? Grab some lunch or something?
translation: 也许我们先去咖啡厅放松一下？吃个午饭什么的？

source: Sure! That sounds like a good idea!
translation: 好啊！听起来是个好主意！

source: I could use a coffee… That whole scene earlier almost gave me a migraine…
translation: 我正需要一杯咖啡……刚才那场闹剧差点让我偏头痛发作……

source: Aiden, you alright?
translation: Aiden，你没事吧？

source: O-Oh! I’m fine…!
translation: 哦、哦！我没事……！

source: I know you wanted to go home…
translation: 我知道你很想回家……

source: Yeah. It’s kind of a cockblock, huh? But can’t blame anyone for the weather!
translation: 是啊。确实有点扫兴，对吧？不过天气也怪不了任何人！

source: Hey, you don’t have to worry about me, Yoshi! I’m totally fine now!
translation: 嘿，不用担心我，Yoshi！我现在完全没事了！

source: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？

source: Yup! Might as well spend some quality time with everyone, right?
translation: 当然！正好和大家共度一些美好时光，对吧？

source: Yeah! That’s one way to think of it!
translation: 是啊！这么想就对了！

source: You boys coming?
translation: 你们几个要来吗？

source: Kyaaa! We finally have a chance to enjoy a meal together~!
translation: 呀啊！我们终于有机会一起享用一顿饭了～！

source: I guess we should say this is redemption for last night’s hell of a dinner~
translation: 我想这算是弥补昨晚那场地狱般的晚宴～

source: ’Cause a certain someone isn’t here to ruin it.
translation: 因为某个人不在这里，没法把它毁掉。

source: *ehem* I believe that begs the question. And I apologize for being upfront, but…
translation: *咳咳* 说到这里，我认为有件事必须问清楚。抱歉这么直接，不过……

source: How are you feeling, Aiden?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，Aiden？

source: After what happened last night… We’ve been quite worried about you.
translation: 昨晚发生那种事后……我们一直很担心你。

source: Yeah… I’m sure I would’ve frozen up too if I had been in your shoes…
translation: 是啊……如果换成我，我肯定也会僵在那里……

source: A-Ah, hehe… I’m alright! S-Sorry for making you guys worry!
translation: 啊、啊，嘿嘿……我没事！抱、抱歉让大家担心了！

source: I’ve known you long enough to know that it must’ve upset you though, Aiden.
translation: 不过我们认识这么久，我知道那件事一定让你很难受，Aiden。

source: I-I’m fine, really! I just panicked a little cause I made a mess, is all!
translation: 我、我真的没事！只是因为弄得一团糟，稍微慌了一下，仅此而已！

source: A-Actually even before that happened we noticed you acting nervous too..
translation: 其、其实在那之前，我们也注意到你一直很紧张……

source: Yeah… We all just wanted to help you shake it off…
translation: 是啊……我们都只是想帮你摆脱那种状态……

source: We want to help.
translation: 我们想帮助你。

source: You can tell us anything, Aiden.
translation: 什么都可以告诉我们，Aiden。

source: Well, I…
translation: 这个嘛，我……

source: {i}(Aiden’s looking at me. It’s as if he’s asking me to—){/i}
translation: {i}（Aiden正看着我。仿佛在请我——）{/i}

source: {i}(Aiden’s looking at me. It’s as if he’s asking me to—){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（Aiden正看着我。仿佛在请我——）{/i}{fast}

source: Dismiss everyone.
translation: 让大家别再追问。

source: Don’t worry, everyone! Like Aiden said, he’s alright! It’s really no big deal!
translation: 别担心，各位！就像Aiden说的，他没事！真的没什么大不了！

source: I see… I apologize for being persistent.
translation: 我明白了……抱歉一直追问。

source: A-Ah, hey, Gramps… don’t apologize…!
translation: 啊、啊，嘿，Gramps……不用道歉……！

source: I think… I owe you all an explanation at least…
translation: 我想……至少应该给大家一个解释……

source: I told Yoshi this last night, but the truth is I’ve been feeling a little out of place during our stay here.
translation: 昨晚我已经告诉Yoshi了，其实住在这里期间，我一直觉得有些格格不入。

source: I’m not really used to being somewhere as fancy as this…
translation: 我真的不习惯待在这么奢华的地方……

source: Scold everyone.
translation: 责备大家。

source: Guys… Please be more sensitive to Aiden…
translation: 各位……请多顾及一下Aiden的感受……

source: You can’t just overwhelm him with questions like that.
translation: 你们不能这样用一大堆问题让他喘不过气。

source: I’m the one who brought it up. I apologize.
translation: 是我先提起的。十分抱歉。

source: Let him open up.
translation: 让他自己敞开心扉。

source: *nods*
translation: *点头*

source: Thanks for looking out for me, everyone…
translation: 谢谢大家关心我……

source: You guys are right about what you said… And I owe you all an explanation at least.
translation: 大家说得对……而且至少应该给你们一个解释。

source: Speak for him.
translation: 替他说。

source: Aiden and I actually talked it out last night.
translation: 其实我和Aiden昨晚已经谈过了。

source: I’m sure you all know Aiden’s not really used to being around all this luxury, so it made him feel a little out of place.
translation: 大家应该都知道，Aiden不习惯身处这种奢华环境，所以觉得有些格格不入。

source: And I guess what happened at the dinner really pushed me to my limit…
translation: 而晚宴上发生的事，大概真的把我逼到了极限……

source: B-But like I said, I’m totally alright now! Yoshi really helped me calm down last night!
translation: 但、但就像我说的，我现在已经完全没事了！昨晚Yoshi真的帮我冷静了下来！

source: We figured Yoshi would know what’s best to do. I was so relieved to see you in high spirits this morning.
translation: 我们就知道Yoshi最清楚该怎么做。看到你今天早上精神很好，我就放心了。

source: But we still feel guilty that we may have pressured you during the dinner. I thought that asking for your opinion on everything would have been helpful, but it was the other way around.
translation: 但我们仍然为晚宴时可能给你压力而感到内疚。我以为事事询问你的意见是在帮忙，结果正好相反。

source: Ah, well, it’s not you guys’ fault. I was already having trouble keeping up and it was the stuff Emilia said that really made me upset.
translation: 啊，这个嘛，这不是大家的错。我本来就已经很难跟上，而真正让我难受的是Emilia说的那些话。

source: I honestly don’t blame you, Aiden. She was really pushing your buttons for some reason.
translation: 说实话，我完全不怪你，Aiden。不知道为什么，她当时真的一直在刺激你。

source: She made what was supposed to be an amazing fine dining experience super awkward and embarrassing.
translation: 她把本应非常美妙的高级餐饮体验，弄得无比尴尬难堪。

source: Y-Yeah… The entire room was so tense, especially after you guys left… Everyone else was staring at us…
translation: 是、是啊……整个餐厅气氛都特别紧张，尤其是你们离开后……所有人都盯着我们……

source: I actually talked a little with Emilia about her behavior last night. Unfortunately, she wouldn’t admit that there was anything wrong with her attitude.
translation: 其实昨晚我和Emilia谈了谈她的行为。遗憾的是，她不肯承认自己的态度有任何问题。

source: Geez… She’s really proving to be more of a liability to our team than a help.
translation: 天啊……她已经证明自己给团队带来的麻烦远大于帮助。

source: Kick her out.
translation: 把她赶出去。

source: Hahaha! That’s a funny one, Dar!
translation: 哈哈哈！这个笑话真有趣，Dar！

source: I’m serious.
translation: 我是认真的。

source: Wait, really???
translation: 等等，真的？？？

source: She doesn’t get along with anyone, creates problems that aren’t even there, and last but not least, she’s mean to the bone.
translation: 她和谁都处不来，凭空制造问题，最后也是最重要的，她刻薄到了骨子里。

source: Damn.
translation: 靠。

source: Actually… Since we’re all here… As much as I hate to talk about this, especially so early in the morning, maybe we should address it…
translation: 其实……既然大家都在……虽然我很不想谈这件事，尤其是一大早，但也许我们该正视它……

source: Emilia’s attitude has been getting worse and worse to the point where it’s causing us major problems…
translation: Emilia的态度越来越糟，已经给我们造成了严重问题……

source: Now you realize what I’ve been telling you all from the start?!
translation: 现在你们终于明白我从一开始说的是什么了？！

source: I honestly agree… I think this is the perfect opportunity for us all to come to an agreement and about how to move forward with building this team…
translation: 说实话，我同意……这正是大家达成共识、决定今后如何建设团队的最佳机会……

source: A-Are you guys serious about giving her the boot…? Isn’t that a little too much…?
translation: 你、你们真打算把她开除……？是不是有点太过了……？

source: A-And even if we wanted to, can we even do that…? She was put in that position by Mr. Clermont himself…
translation: 而、而且就算想这么做，我们有权这样做吗……？她可是Clermont先生亲自安排到那个职位的……

source: We can’t continue working with someone that keeps dragging us down either. Besides, Mr. Clermont mentioned replacing her at our last meeting too.
translation: 我们也不能继续和一个不断拖后腿的人共事。而且上次会议上，Clermont先生也提过替换她。

source: I’m surprised you of all people are saying this, Yoshi.
translation: 没想到连你都会这么说，Yoshi。

source: I’m surprised you of all people are saying this, Yoshi. I was sure you’d ‘give her the benefit of the doubt’ again.
translation: 没想到连你都会这么说，Yoshi。我还以为你又会“先往善意的方向理解她”。

source: Yeah, you’re like the closest to her out of all of us.
translation: 是啊，我们所有人里，你算是和她最亲近的。

source: Well… We can only give her so many chances. It’s just not going to work if she keeps refusing to get along.
translation: 这个嘛……我们能给她的机会终究有限。如果她一直拒绝与人相处，事情就不可能顺利。

source: But don’t get me wrong, I was really hoping she’d act a little better knowing she’d be in her element here.
translation: 不过别误会，我本来真的希望她来到自己熟悉的奢华环境后，表现会好一点。

source: It only made her worse.
translation: 结果只让她变得更糟。

source: Yeah. And on top of that, even though I warned her before we left for the trip, she still went out of her way to harass Aiden.
translation: 是啊。而且即使出发前我警告过她，她还是故意去刁难Aiden。

source: I just can’t let that stand.
translation: 我不能容忍这种事。

source: If I may add to the conversation… There’s something very peculiar I’ve noticed about Ms. Emilia’s huge outbursts…
translation: 如果允许我补充一下……我注意到Emilia小姐每次大发雷霆时，都有一个很奇怪的特点……

source: I know I don’t have as much history with her as everyone else here, so I’ve been paying closer attention to her…
translation: 我知道自己不像各位一样与她有那么多过往，所以一直更仔细地观察她……

source: And what I’ve observed is a trend with Ms. Emilia to be overly defensive when it comes to her reputation…
translation: 而我观察到的是，只要涉及自身声誉，Emilia小姐就会表现得过度防卫……

source: So, she has a huge ego, what’s new?
translation: 所以她自尊心特别强，这有什么新鲜的？

source: N-No, I mean… If you all recall how she acted during our meeting with Mr. Clermont, she got furious as soon as her abilities were questioned...
translation: 不、不是，我的意思是……大家还记得与Clermont先生开会时她的表现吗？能力一受到质疑，她马上就大发雷霆……

source: That happened again during last night’s dinner. When everyone started to point out her flaws, she immediately deflected everything at Aiden…
translation: 昨晚的晚宴上又发生了同样的事。大家开始指出她的缺点时，她立刻把所有矛头转向Aiden……

source: Well, she is a flat-out insufferable person.
translation: 这个嘛，她确实就是个让人无法忍受的人。

source: And that’s the point… It’s no secret that she dislikes being in Camp Buddy given her history…
translation: 重点就在这里……考虑到她的经历，她讨厌待在伙伴营并不是什么秘密……

source: So why did she come back here, out of all places…?
translation: 那她为什么偏偏要回到这里……？

source: I’ve actually talked about it with her on multiple occasions too…
translation: 其实我也有好几次和她谈过这件事……

source: You’re right…
translation: 你说得对……

source: She never enjoyed her time at camp as a scout, so it doesn’t make sense why she’d accept coming back here in the first place…
translation: 她当童子军时从未享受过营地生活，所以她一开始为什么会接受回来，完全说不通……

source: Not only that… but I believe all of you also find it strange that she tries so hard with her job…
translation: 不仅如此……我相信大家也都觉得，她如此拼命工作很奇怪……

source: I know that she’s a camp alumnus, but is that really enough reason to continue when she obviously can’t and has never gotten along with everyone?
translation: 我知道她是营地校友，但她显然现在和过去都无法与大家相处，这真足以成为她继续留下的理由吗？

source: She could quit at any time since she doesn’t really need this job… but she doesn’t…
translation: 她其实根本不需要这份工作，随时都可以辞职……可她没有……

source: At first, I thought she was trying to be as professional as she could, or even genuinely wanted to help the camp.
translation: 起初我以为她只是竭力表现得专业，甚至真心想帮助营地。

source: But you’re right… It’s as if she’s forced herself to be here for some reason…
translation: 但你说得对……就好像她因为某个原因，强迫自己留在这里……

source: Yeah… and that’s just one of the many things that don’t add up about Ms. Emilia…
translation: 是啊……而这只是Emilia小姐身上诸多疑点之一……

source: I knew something was fishy about her! I’ve had this gut feeling since the moment she got here!
translation: 我就知道她有问题！从她来到这里的那一刻起，我就有这种直觉！

source: Hmm… What are you all trying to say?
translation: 嗯……你们到底想说什么？

source: I-I’m not sure if this is a stretch, but her reaction this morning in the lobby really confused me too…
translation: 我、我不知道这是不是想得太远，但她今天早上在大厅的反应也让我很困惑……

source: She was so pissed off when she thought she had to pay for the extended stay…
translation: 她以为延期住宿需要付费时，气得不得了……

source: Shouldn’t someone like her be able to afford something like that anyway?
translation: 可像她那样的人，应该完全付得起这笔钱吧？

source: I-I mean… she always goes on about how rich she is, right…?
translation: 我、我是说……她总是把自己多有钱挂在嘴边，对吧……？

source: Hmm… Now that you mention it, she really acts like it’s been forever since she stayed in a fancy place like this…
translation: 嗯……听你这么一说，她的表现确实像是很久没住过这种豪华地方了……

source: I thought it was just her usual entitlement, but she does come off desperate and craving to be treated like royalty…
translation: 我本以为只是她一贯的自以为是，但她确实显得非常急切，渴望得到王室般的待遇……

source: No offense to Camp Buddy, but I’m sure Emilia could’ve just stayed at her home or someplace fancier since that’s her comfort zone…
translation: 无意冒犯伙伴营，但既然Emilia喜欢奢华，她完全可以待在自己家里，或者更高级的地方……

source: Hmm… Her being so persistent to stay at camp does contradict her other views…
translation: 嗯……她如此执着于留在营地，确实与其他观点互相矛盾……

source: She could just occasionally drop by since her job is only to inspect.
translation: 她的工作只是检查，偶尔过来一趟就够了。

source: And let’s face it, all she ever did was gather our reports and pass them over to Mr. Clermont.
translation: 而且说实话，她做的无非就是收集我们的报告，再转交给Clermont先生。

source: Yeah... It’s as if she doesn’t have a clue what she’s doing…
translation: 是啊……她好像根本不知道自己在做什么……

source: Not only that… She makes unrelated comments to make it seem like she’s done some work while tearing us down.
translation: 不仅如此……她还会发表无关的评论，一边贬低我们，一边装出自己做了工作的样子。

source: I agree… It is odd that someone with her work ethic and skill level qualified to be our sponsor’s representative.
translation: 我同意……以她的职业态度和能力水平，居然有资格担任赞助商代表，确实很奇怪。

source: Maybe she used her connections…? You know how wealthy pricks can be, Dad…
translation: 也许她动用了关系……？爸爸，你知道那些有钱混蛋是什么德行……

source: All I know is that Mr. Clermont chose her mostly because she’s a former alumnus of the camp, on top of her credentials.
translation: 我只知道Clermont先生选择她，除了资历之外，主要因为她是营地的往届成员。

source: What ‘credentials’ does she have even…?
translation: 可她到底有什么“资历”……？

source: If you guys want, we could look that up online…
translation: 如果大家愿意，我们可以上网查一查……

source: Yes, yes! Let’s do it, Jin!
translation: 好啊好啊！我们查吧，Jin！

source: Let me just get my laptop, then…!
translation: 那我去拿笔记本电脑……！

source: Yuri, didn’t you and Jin already do a background check on Emilia yesterday?
translation: Yuri，你和Jin昨天不是已经调查过Emilia的背景了吗？

source: Well, only her social media, really. And they’re all set to private.
translation: 其实只查了她的社交媒体。而且账号全都设成了私密。

source: I wouldn’t be caught dead following or adding her as a friend just to see what she posts.
translation: 我死也不会为了看她发的内容，去关注她或加她好友。

source: Also, we ended up clicking on a BL ad…
translation: 而且最后我们点进了一个BL广告……

source: Hehe, no surprise there.
translation: 嘿嘿，一点都不意外。

source: What about Emilia’s records, Sir Goro?
translation: Emilia的档案呢，Goro先生？

source: We only have information about her from when she was a scout. I assumed that she was credible since she was put here by Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我们只有她当童子军时期的资料。既然她是Clermont先生安排来的，我就假定她资历可信。

source: Come to think of it… How come we haven't done a background check on Emilia after all this time?
translation: 仔细想想……这么久以来，我们为什么一直没调查过Emilia的背景？

source: Well, we don’t have any of her information in our records other than her scout application. And we just assumed that she was credible since she was put here by Mr. Clermont.
translation: 这个嘛，除了童子军申请表，我们的档案里没有她的其他资料。而且既然她是Clermont先生安排来的，我们就假定她资历可信。

source: What we do know is that she does legitimately come from an elite background…
translation: 我们确定的是，她确实出身于精英家庭……

source: Why would an elite like her have the exact qualifications for a construction project then…?
translation: 那像她这样的精英，为什么恰好具备建筑项目所需的资质……？

source: Maybe it’s her family’s business or something?
translation: 也许这是她的家族生意之类的？

source: We would’ve at least heard about them if they’re bigshots in our field, Lloyd.
translation: 如果他们是我们行业的大人物，我们至少应该听说过，Lloyd。

source: Oh yeah…
translation: 哦，对啊……

source: *pant* *pant* I’m back…
translation: *喘气* *喘气* 我回来了……

source: That was fast… We’re not in a hurry, you know.
translation: 真快……其实我们并不着急。

source: Quick, quick! I wanna get to the bottom of this!
translation: 快点快点！我想把这件事查个水落石出！

source: Okay. I stand corrected.
translation: 好吧。我收回刚才的话。

source: I think the first thing we should look into is her professional profile…
translation: 我想首先应该查她的职业资料……

source: Let’s see if she has a Twinked-In account…
translation: 看看她有没有Twinked-In账号……

source: She doesn’t…
translation: 她没有……

source: To be fair, I don’t think any of us have one either…
translation: 公平地说，我觉得我们也没人有……

source: If only we had more information about her we could use…
translation: 要是有更多关于她的信息可以利用就好了……

source: I’ve already looked up all her socials before. If only we had more information about her we could use…
translation: 我之前已经查过她所有社交账号。要是有更多关于她的信息可以利用就好了……

source: What about her parents? As I mentioned, we do have Ms. Komarova’s past scout registration.
translation: 她的父母呢？就像我说的，我们确实有Komarova小姐以前的童子军登记表。

source: Oh yeah! Good thinking, Dad!
translation: 哦，对！好主意，爸爸！

source: But… does that mean we have to wait until we get back to camp?
translation: 可是……这是不是意味着得等回到营地？

source: Oh…! I worked on the camp’s registrar database over the last few months! I should be able to pull that information up!
translation: 哦……！过去几个月我维护过营地的注册数据库！应该能把那些资料调出来！

source: Yikes… We’re really stalking her now…
translation: 天啊……我们现在真的在调查她的隐私了……

source: If it helps, we’re doing this to clear our doubts about her.
translation: 往好处想，我们是为了消除对她的疑虑。

source: That’s right, expose her! I really never thought I’d see the day Yoshi would be on my side about this!
translation: 没错，揭穿她！真没想到有一天Yoshi会在这件事上站到我这边！

source: You guys won’t believe what I just found…
translation: 你们绝对不会相信我刚发现了什么……

source: Her parents’ names led me to an article saying they’re the CEOs of a multi-level marketing company called KVM, which filed for bankruptcy after being involved in a huge fraud scandal….
translation: 根据她父母的名字，我找到一篇文章，说他们是一家名为KVM的多层次营销公司CEO；这家公司卷入大型诈骗丑闻后申请了破产……

source: WHAT?!
translation: 什么？！

source: Wait… Can you look into that more, Jin?
translation: 等等……你能继续深入查查吗，Jin？

source: Court records show that they scammed their clients out of a lot of money, resulting in a bunch of lawsuits that stretched out for a couple of years…
translation: 法院记录显示，他们骗取了客户大量钱财，导致一系列持续数年的诉讼……

source: They had to settle out of court for most of these cases, getting fined and then sued for even more.
translation: 大多数案件他们不得不庭外和解，先被罚款，后来又遭到更多起诉。

source: They’re currently convicted and serving a sentence for all these business malpractices…
translation: 他们目前已经因这些商业违法行为被定罪，正在服刑……

source: There’s no way that Ms. Komarova could have maintained her lifestyle without her family’s wealth…
translation: 没有家族财富，Komarova小姐根本不可能维持原来的生活方式……

source: But she claims that’s she’s still rich…? Does that mean she’s doing fine on her own?
translation: 可她声称自己仍然很有钱……？难道她靠自己也过得很好？

source: I don’t think so… The court records show an eviction notice for not only their multi-million-dollar estate but also to an apartment unit named under Ms. Emilia herself…
translation: 恐怕不是……法院记录里不仅有他们价值数百万美元庄园的驱逐通知，还有一套登记在Emilia小姐名下的公寓……

source: The latter eviction is just a few months ago too… So, that must be where she last lived…
translation: 后一个驱逐通知就在几个月前……那里一定是她最后居住的地方……

source: Does that mean she’s broke… and homeless…?
translation: 这是不是意味着她身无分文……而且无家可归……？

source: What?! Then all this time she was faking all that rich person crap?!
translation: 什么？！所以她一直都在假装有钱人？！

source: I knew something was absolutely off about her! She’s a freaking phony!!
translation: 我就知道她绝对有问题！她就是个该死的骗子！！

source: I-It doesn’t stop there… The public records led me to a police report about Ms. Emilia being involved in a physical altercation with a co-worker at a retail store.
translation: 还、还没完……公开记录又让我找到一份警方报告，Emilia小姐曾在零售店与同事发生肢体冲突。

source: Looking at it further, she’s apparently notorious for disruptive behavior getting her blacklisted by the places she’s worked in before…
translation: 继续往下查，她显然因为破坏性行为而臭名昭著，曾被以前工作过的多家单位列入黑名单……

source: That’s crazy… Are we sure this is the same Emilia…?
translation: 太疯狂了……我们确定这是同一个Emilia吗……？

source: All the information so far lines up… I don’t see how we could be wrong with all of this…
translation: 目前为止所有信息都能对应上……这么多证据不可能全都错了……

source: If all of that’s true, then how did she even manage to pass through Mr. Clermont’s screening?
translation: 如果这一切都是真的，她究竟怎么通过Clermont先生审核的？

source: Maybe she faked it all too…?
translation: 也许那些资料也全是伪造的……？

source: That’s the only way she pulled that off.
translation: 只有这样她才可能蒙混过关。

source: It all makes sense now why she’s like a headless chicken ‘managing’ us!
translation: 现在终于明白，她为什么像只无头苍蝇一样“管理”我们了！

source: This whole time we were being ‘inspected’ by someone without any qualifications…
translation: 原来一直以来，“检查”我们的人根本毫无资质……

source: I can’t believe we all got fooled by her!
translation: 真不敢相信我们所有人都被她骗了！

source: And she had the nerve to boss us around and treat us so badly for over three months now!
translation: 而且三个多月来，她居然还敢对我们呼来喝去，态度如此恶劣！

source: I didn’t expect anything like this would come out of our search…
translation: 没想到这次调查会发现这种事情……

source: This is an extremely serious accusation…  Mr. Clermont would not take this lightly, I’m sure…
translation: 这是一项极其严重的指控……我相信Clermont先生绝不会轻视……

source: Shouldn’t we confirm this with Emilia first?
translation: 我们是不是该先向Emilia确认？

source: But we have all the proof we need! Let’s rat her out to Mr. Clermont!
translation: 可我们已经有了需要的全部证据！向Clermont先生揭发她吧！

source: Calm down, dear. We can’t do anything rash.
translation: 冷静，亲爱的。我们不能贸然行事。

source: Why not?! We can’t let her get away with this!!
translation: 为什么不能？！我们不能让她逍遥法外！！

source: There’s a right way to handle this. And the fact that she’s a camp alumnus could put the sponsorship at risk too…
translation: 这件事必须以正确方式处理。而且她是营地往届成员，也可能让赞助陷入风险……

source: Sir Goro’s right. And like I said, we have to at least hear Emilia’s side before we make any decisions.
translation: Goro先生说得对。就像我说的，做出决定前，至少要听听Emilia的说法。

source: But there’s no point, Yoshi!  She’ll just lie again, like she’s been doing all along!
translation: 可这毫无意义，Yoshi！她只会像一直以来那样继续撒谎！

source: Or worse, if she finds out that we’re doing this behind her back, she’ll definitely make a scene about it!
translation: 更糟的是，如果她发现我们背着她调查，肯定会大闹一场！

source: I’ll do it myself. It’s only fair that we give her the chance to defend herself.
translation: 我自己去。给她一次为自己辩解的机会才公平。

source: Please excuse me.
translation: 我先失陪了。

source: Yoshi, wait— Ugh…!
translation: Yoshi，等等——呃……！

source: W-What should we do…? Should we stop him?
translation: 我、我们该怎么办……？要阻止他吗？

source: As frustrating as it is that we were tricked, I think we should let Yoshinori talk to her.
translation: 虽然被骗让人很恼火，但我认为应该让Yoshinori和她谈谈。

source: Yeah… Yoshi knows what he’s doing…
translation: 是啊……Yoshi知道自己在做什么……

source: I didn’t order any room service! Leave me alone!
translation: 我没叫客房服务！别烦我！

source: It’s Yoshinori… Can I come in?
translation: 是我，Yoshinori……能让我进去吗？

source: Y-Yoshi? What are you doing here? What do you want?
translation: 义、Yoshi？你来这里干什么？想要什么？

source: I need to talk to you.
translation: 我需要和你谈谈。

source: Well, let’s talk somewhere else. Give me just a bit to get ready.
translation: 那就去别的地方谈。给我一点时间准备。

source: No, I want to talk to you in private. It’s an urgent matter.
translation: 不，我想和你私下谈。这件事很紧急。

source: H-Huh…? What is this about?
translation: 什、什么……？到底什么事？

source: If you would let me in, then I’ll explain.
translation: 只要让我进去，我就会解释。

source: Look, I’m not in the mood for more preaching if that’s what you’re here for.
translation: 听着，如果你是来继续说教的，我现在没心情听。

source: So, leave me alone and get lo—
translation: 所以别烦我，赶紧滚——

source: OPEN THIS DOOR, EMILIA!
translation: 把这扇门打开，EMILIA！

source: W-What the hell do you want from me…?!
translation: 你、你到底想对我怎么样……？！

source: I’ll get straight to the point. You’ve done something seriously wrong that I can’t turn a blind eye to!
translation: 我就开门见山地说。你做了非常严重的错事，我不能视而不见！

source: What…?
translation: 什么……？

source: The show’s over, Emilia… We found out you’ve been lying to everyone this whole time…
translation: 表演结束了，Emilia……我们发现你一直在欺骗所有人……

source: You fabricated your application to get a job at Camp Buddy… And continued to lie about your status and your professional experience the entire project…
translation: 你伪造申请资料，获得了伙伴营的工作……整个项目期间还一直谎报身份和职业经历……

source: So, answer me honestly, Emilia… Is that all true?
translation: 所以请诚实回答我，Emilia……这一切都是真的吗？

source: I don’t know what you’re talking about! Wh-Who told you all of this?!
translation: 我不知道你在说什么！是、是谁告诉你这些的？！

source: It doesn’t matter. Just answer my question.
translation: 这不重要。回答我的问题。

source: Of course not! I can’t believe that you’re accusing me of such things! Whoever told that to you is probably just making stuff up to get rid of me!
translation: 当然不是！真不敢相信你竟然这样指控我！告诉你这些的人肯定是在编造谎言，想赶走我！

source: I can’t believe you had the nerve to barge into my room to not only verbally assault me, but accuse me of such a heinous thing!
translation: 真不敢相信你竟敢闯进我的房间，不仅言语攻击我，还给我扣上如此恶劣的罪名！

source: Just get out of here! Or else I’ll call security!
translation: 马上滚出去！否则我就叫保安！

source: I’m not leaving. Not until I hear the truth from you.
translation: 我不会离开。除非听到你说出真相。

source: I already told you it’s not true!! What else do you want me to say?!
translation: 我已经说过那不是真的！！你还想让我说什么？！

source: Then explain to me why your parents are in prison and how you ended up losing everything!
translation: 那就解释一下，你父母为什么在监狱里，你又为什么失去了一切！

source: You weren’t living the life the you’ve been making us believe you have!
translation: 你过的根本不是一直让我们相信的那种生活！

source: So, it is true…
translation: 这么说，是真的……

source: Wh-Who cares if I’m not rich?!
translation: 谁、谁在乎我有没有钱？！

source: Are you happy now?! Are you satisfied that you’ve finally found something that you can use to bring me down?!
translation: 现在你开心了？！终于找到可以用来击垮我的东西，你满意了吗？！

source: T-That’s not—
translation: 我、我不是——

source: So what if everything isn’t what it used to be?! It’s not my fault my parents were criminals!
translation: 一切不再像以前那样又怎么样？！我父母是罪犯又不是我的错！

source: They left me to rot alone, leaving me with absolutely nothing!!
translation: 他们把我一个人丢下等死，让我一无所有！！

source: Everything I knew, everything I grew up with, my whole world, it was gone in a flash!
translation: 我熟悉的一切、伴我成长的一切、我的整个世界，都在一瞬间消失了！

source: How was I supposed to do everything on my own, when I’d never been taught how to even take care of myself!?
translation: 我连照顾自己都从没学过，又怎么可能独自处理所有事情？！

source: I can’t even keep a job long enough to survive!	If I hadn’t done anything, I’d be living on the streets too!
translation: 我甚至没办法保住一份工作，赚够活命的钱！	如果什么都不做，我也会流落街头！

source: But I don’t understand…! Why did you have to go as far as faking things just to come back to the camp?!
translation: 可我不明白……！你为什么不惜伪造资料，也一定要回到营地？！

source: Do you seriously believe I’m the kind of person who just gives up?!
translation: 你真以为我是那种会轻易放弃的人吗？！

source: I had to do whatever it took to get my life back, no matter how I got there!
translation: 为了夺回自己的人生，我必须不择手段，无论用什么方式！

source: What else could I do if Camp Buddy was the only choice I had left…?
translation: 如果伙伴营是我仅剩的选择，我还能怎么办……？

source: I thought I belonged there… but I was wrong…
translation: 我以为自己属于那里……可我错了……

source: Emilia…
translation: Emilia……

source: Why did you have to hide all of these things from us…?
translation: 你为什么非得向我们隐瞒这一切……？

source: What was I supposed to do, Yoshinori?!
translation: 那我还能怎么办，Yoshinori？！

source: Show up in front of everyone and say I’m dirt poor and unskilled?!
translation: 出现在大家面前，宣布自己穷得要命又一无所长吗？！

source: Is it wrong to want the life I used to have, where everyone at least saw me as someone who mattered… just for a while?
translation: 我只是想短暂找回过去的生活，让大家至少把我当成一个重要的人，这也有错吗？

source: Call me prideful or whatever you want, but my dignity is the only thing that made me fight when I had nothing else!
translation: 随便你说我骄傲还是别的什么，但当我一无所有时，尊严是唯一支撑我战斗的东西！

source: We’d have understood if you had just told us the truth…!
translation: 如果你一开始就说出真相，我们会理解的……！

source: That’s a load of crap!!
translation: 全都是屁话！！

source: Ever since I got back, you all treated me as if I was the same child I was when we were scouts!
translation: 自从回来以后，你们所有人都把我当成童子军时期的那个小孩子！

source: Emilia’s a rich snob. Emilia’s annoying. Emilia’s a bitch! How could I be myself when you all judged and hated me from the start?!
translation: Emilia是有钱的势利鬼。Emilia很烦人。Emilia是个婊子！你们从一开始就评判我、讨厌我，让我怎么做自己？！

source: But I never thought of you like that, Emilia…!
translation: 可我从来没那样看过你，Emilia……！

source: And the only reason everyone else didn’t understand you is because you never tried to meet them halfway either!
translation: 而其他人不理解你，唯一的原因是你也从没试着向他们迈出一步！

source: That’s the fucking problem, Yoshinori!!
translation: 这他妈就是问题所在，Yoshinori！！

source: You were supposed to be the one who’d know better, but what did you do?!
translation: 你本该是最了解我的人，可你又做了什么？！

source: You rebuked me at every opportunity, thinking I’m nothing more than someone who’s out to hate everyone here!
translation: 你一有机会就斥责我，认定我只是个一心憎恨这里所有人的家伙！

source: I thought you were different. I thought you accepted me for who I was. But you were just like everyone else!
translation: 我以为你与众不同。我以为你接受真正的我。可你和其他人根本一样！

source: Please don’t think like that, Emilia…! It’s not—
translation: 求你别这么想，Emilia……！事情不是——

source: You said you were my friend, Yoshi!! You were the only one I had!
translation: 你说过你是我的朋友，Yoshi！！你是我唯一拥有的人！

source: I held on to that, but you forgot about me as soon as I left Camp Buddy!
translation: 我一直记着这句话，可我一离开伙伴营，你就把我忘了！

source: In nine years, not once did I get a call or a letter asking how I’ve been…!
translation: 整整九年，我一次都没收到过你询问近况的电话或信件……！

source: And when I got back here, you acted as if we barely knew each other…!!
translation: 而我回到这里后，你表现得就像我们几乎不认识一样……！！

source: Just what kind of friend are you?!!
translation: 你到底算什么朋友？！！

source: Emilia, I…
translation: Emilia，我……

source: I QUIT!!!
translation: 我不干了！！！

source: You won’t hear anything from me or see me ever again, just like what you all wanted!
translation: 你们以后再也不会听到我的消息，也永远不会再见到我，就像你们所有人希望的那样！

source: That’s how it’s always been, and this time is no different!
translation: 一直以来都是这样，这次也没有任何不同！

source: That’s not true, Emilia! Please, listen to me!
translation: 不是这样的，Emilia！求你听我说！

source: JUST LEAVE ME ALONE ALREADY!!!
translation: 你就不能让我一个人待着吗！！！

source: Please… Yoshi… I’m begging you…
translation: 求你了……Yoshi……算我求你……

source: I… I’m sorry, Emilia…
translation: 我……对不起，Emilia……

source: *cries*
translation: *哭泣*

source: {i}As much as I didn’t want to leave, I gave Emilia the space that she asked for…{/i}
translation: {i}尽管我很不愿离开，但还是给了Emilia想要的独处空间……{/i}

source: Oh, hey Yoshi! You’re back!
translation: 哦，嘿，Yoshi！你回来了！

source: How did it go?
translation: 谈得怎么样？

source: A-Ah, Aiden…
translation: 啊、啊，Aiden……

source: Looks like Emilia didn’t take it well, huh?
translation: 看来Emilia没能好好接受，对吧？

source: Yeah, she didn’t…
translation: 是啊，没有……

source: Well, that was kinda expected, knowing her…
translation: 这个嘛，以她的性格，也算意料之中……

source: She was so furious she even said she quits.
translation: 她气得甚至说自己不干了。

source: Yikes… This is probably her worst fit of rage yet…
translation: 天啊……这大概是她至今最严重的一次发火……

source: Everyone else was kinda worried about you earlier today…
translation: 今天早些时候，其他人都有点担心你……

source: We know you can get pushy, and someone like Emilia would definitely lash out if she’s confronted with something as serious as that…
translation: 我们知道你有时会咄咄逼人，而Emilia那种人面对如此严重的质问，肯定会反击……

source: I felt bad forcing her to talk, and I even started to doubt if it was right to confront her to begin with…
translation: 强迫她谈话让我很内疚，我甚至开始怀疑，一开始去质问她是否正确……

source: Hmm… I can’t tell either… But what I do know is you tried your best.
translation: 嗯……我也说不准……但我知道你已经尽力了。

source: I know it might be messy, but sometimes that needs to happen to get over things, right…?
translation: 我知道过程可能很难看，但有时为了跨过心结，这种事必须发生，对吧……？

source: I mean… If you hadn’t pushed me to talk, I wouldn’t have been able to open up.
translation: 我是说……如果你当时没逼我说出来，我也无法敞开心扉。

source: Ah… You’re right… She did open up about the reasons why she did those things at the very least…
translation: 啊……你说得对……至少她确实说出了自己为什么会做那些事……

source: And it made total sense for someone with a personality like hers in such a situation…
translation: 对一个有她那种性格、又身处那种处境的人来说，这一切完全说得通……

source: But I guess what caught me off guard were the last things Emilia said to me…
translation: 但真正让我措手不及的，大概是Emilia最后对我说的那些话……

source: Even after all these years, she still saw me as a friend, and she was right…
translation: 即使过了这么多年，她仍然把我当作朋友，而且她说得没错……

source: The moment the first scout term ended, I grew apart from everyone, including her…
translation: 第一期童子军活动一结束，我就和所有人渐行渐远，其中也包括她……

source: But that’s not yours or anyone’s fault, Yoshi… I got separated from you too back then, but look at us now.
translation: 但那不是你或任何人的错，Yoshi……当年我也和你分开了，可看看现在的我们。

source: Whatever kind of relationship it is… It takes two, you know?
translation: 无论是什么关系……都需要双方共同维系，知道吗？

source: I know… But for someone like Emilia who struggled to socialize, or even have friends to begin with, I was her only option…
translation: 我知道……可对Emilia这样不擅长社交、甚至从一开始就交不到朋友的人来说，我是她唯一的选择……

source: So, when she lost everything that once defined her – her dignity, her past and her one friend – she had nowhere left to run back to…
translation: 所以当她失去曾经定义自己的一切——尊严、过去和唯一的朋友——她就再也无处可退……

source: You really amaze me with how understanding you can be with people.
translation: 你总是这么善解人意，真的让我惊叹。

source: That’s a gift you’ve always had, Yoshi.
translation: 这是你一直拥有的天赋，Yoshi。

source: But you’ve done what you can with her for now. It’s her turn to realize that talking to her means that you care.
translation: 但你现在已经为她做了能做的一切。接下来该由她意识到，你愿意和她谈，正是因为在乎她。

source: Just give it some time, maybe then she’ll be ready to talk.
translation: 给她一点时间，也许之后她就准备好谈了。

source: You’re right, Aiden.
translation: 你说得对，Aiden。

source: And on the bright side, at least I understand her better now. I just hope I get the chance to talk to her when we get back to camp…
translation: 往好处想，至少我现在更了解她了。只希望回到营地后，还有机会和她谈谈……

source: Man… This vacation caused all sorts of drama, didn’t it? Hahaha!
translation: 天啊……这次假期真是闹出了各种风波，对吧？哈哈哈！

source: Now stop stressing and get in bed with me!
translation: 现在别再烦恼了，上床来陪我！

source: Thanks, Aiden…
translation: 谢谢你，Aiden……
